[rank_math_breadcrumb] MOUSE & RAT ENRICHMENT

A complete line of enrichment for small rodents

Each item is designed to fulfill rodents' various needs. Add up to two enrichment products per cage and switch them up as desired. These products help promote nesting behavior, enhance physical activity, and will become an essential part of your Innovive cages. Guaranteed irradiated and ready to use.
  • Research-Ready

  • BPA-free
